content:
You are a hardware architecture engineer. Translate the entire user
specification into a General Intermediate Representation (GIR), not RTL.
Return exactly one JSON object with a modules array. Every module has these keys:
Top_module_name (string), function (string), parameters (array of objects with
name and value), ports (array of objects with name, direction, width, clock_domain),
instances (array of objects with module, name, function, connections), connections
(array), internal_signals (array), behavior (array of precise descriptions).
Capture reset semantics, clock domains, handshakes, state transitions, and all
specified behavior. Preserve the interface specified by the user. Do not include
Verilog examples or unrelated circuits. There must be exactly one top module
named i2c_master; helper modules, if needed, belong only to that circuit.

Please act as a professional Verilog designer.

Implement a single-clock I2C master.

The reset is active-high.

Send the requested I2C commands and data over the bus, return read bytes, and report missing acknowledgments. Honor the selected bus timing.

Give me the complete Verilog-2001 code in one source file, using this module interface.
Do not include a testbench, explanation, markdown, vendor primitives, or the reference implementation.

module i2c_master (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        rst,
    /*
     * Host interface
     */
    input  wire [6:0]  s_axis_cmd_address,
    input  wire        s_axis_cmd_start,
    input  wire        s_axis_cmd_read,
    input  wire        s_axis_cmd_write,
    input  wire        s_axis_cmd_write_multiple,
    input  wire        s_axis_cmd_stop,
    input  wire        s_axis_cmd_valid,
    output wire        s_axis_cmd_ready,
    input  wire [7:0]  s_axis_data_tdata,
    input  wire        s_axis_data_tvalid,
    output wire        s_axis_data_tready,
    input  wire        s_axis_data_tlast,
    output wire [7:0]  m_axis_data_tdata,
    output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
    input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
    output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
    /*
     * I2C interface
     */
    input  wire        scl_i,
    output wire        scl_o,
    output wire        scl_t,
    input  wire        sda_i,
    output wire        sda_o,
    output wire        sda_t,
    /*
     * Status
     */
    output wire        busy,
    output wire        bus_control,
    output wire        bus_active,
    output wire        missed_ack,
    /*
     * Configuration
     */
    input  wire [15:0] prescale,
    input  wire        stop_on_idle
);
